findings.severity: systemic, affects all four families in this shard
findings.objection: regionHeading and effectiveLabel are attributed across columns and across rows, so the protection decision is frequently made on text that does not belong to the field.
findings.observedResult: The petitioner name / street / city block occupies one column at x=37-38 with a shared width of 278. Its three widgets receive three different region headings, each a different line of the form's title block in the adjacent right-hand column: on AOC-CR-287 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a) OR G.S. 15A-146(a1)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-288 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a2)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-296 'STATE VERSUS', 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION' and 'AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION'; on AOC-CR-298 'STATE VERSUS', '(NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))' and 'G.S. 15A-145.5, -150'. Separately, effectiveLabel is a whole caption row rather than a field's own caption: PetitionerState, PetitionerZip, DriversLicenseState, Race and Sex on AOC-CR-287, and State, ZipCode, DLState and NameAtty on AOC-CR-288, all carry the identical label 'Drivers License No.StateRaceSex'; DateOfBirth, Sex and AgeAtTimeOfOffense on AOC-CR-287 and DOB and CityAtty on AOC-CR-288 all carry the identical label 'Date Of BirthFull Social Security No.' followed by an undecoded run. The refusal categories that result are untrue on their face: PetitionerZip and NameAtty refused as 'race', DOB and CityAtty refused as 'money', DateOfBirth refused as 'money'. Most such misfires are fail-closed and cost only a false reason, but on AOC-CR-296 the same mechanism refuses two fields the participant must complete, and PROTECT_RULES order means an accidental early match ('money', 'race') pre-empts the correct later rule ('attorney') that the module was extended to catch.
findings.requiredResult: A widget's region is the section heading that governs its own column band, and a widget's effectiveLabel is its own caption, not the concatenation of every caption in the row. A refusal names the reason that actually applies.
findings.smallestCorrection: Constrain region attribution to headings whose horizontal extent overlaps the widget's column, and constrain caption attribution to the caption cell above or left of the widget within that column, rather than the whole row. Re-derive the maps and re-render; no family file is hand-edited.
findings.whyItMattersEvenWhereOutputIsClean: §5 says not to infer safety from a missing class. This is the same hazard with a class present: the class is recorded, is relied on, and is demonstrably not about the field it is attached to. Where it happens to fail closed the artifact is still correct; there is no guarantee the next form fails in the safe direction.
